items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: when he was playing with Eubie Blake

ctx.x: Well, that's amazing. I don't see how he could do that.

I couldn't figure that. But you could. I mean, each time (inaudible) I don't think that was faked, or anything. No, I'm pretty sure. It's a thing he did out of Colorado last year, when he was playing with Eubie Blake, you know, the oldest and the youngest there. And he played "Memories of You." And you could see his teeth. I don't know how he did that.
I understand. He must have the talent.
